verdict.rationale: The SDK automatically writes sessions to disk and can resume or fork them with full prior context. A SessionStore adapter can mirror transcripts to a database or object store so sessions resume across hosts. CLAUDE.md project instructions and file read/write tools provide a filesystem-based way to carry knowledge across sessions. However, this is per-session transcript persistence plus DIY file-based notes, not a dedicated long-term memory layer shared across threads. Missing for 10: a first-class memory store or tool shared across separate sessions/threads, memory retrieval/management APIs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
